data.gender_notes: Bryanty is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek name 'Bryas' meaning 'strong, powerful' or 'Brynn' meaning 'hill'. The name Bryanty is a modern, spiritual variation of these ancient names, symbolizing the inner strength and resilience of the bearer. The name Bryanty carries the meaning “Bringer of strength” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Bryanty usually hope their child will grow to embody bringer of strength and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Bryanty total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
